Gotcha! project decisions (2026-10-24)
- Game: "Gotcha!", multiplayer iPhone-landscape browser game. Gyroscope look, side-by-side stereo with a Stereo/Normal toggle (Normal is the default).
- Repo: kumabefamily4/gotcha. Hosting: Vercel.
- Realtime: Ably free tier. API key goes in the Vercel env var ABLY_API_KEY, never in chat. Voice and positions go peer-to-peer over WebRTC and need a free TURN relay.
- Music: free, royalty-free J-Pop-style tracks, credited. Use separate tracks for the lobby and gameplay.
- User preference: plain, neutral, no flattery.

Kumabe wants "Gotcha!": browser 3D game (Three.js), iPhone landscape, gyro 360 look, left joystick, right jump+action buttons (jump lower-left, action upper-right), mini-map top-right (blue self, red goal shown only after all items), multiplayer lobby by share URL, host picks items-per-player and starts, usernames, voice chat via mic, skateboarder-style humanoids, procedural pastel city (baby blue, teal, late-day yellow, orange), J-Pop-style BGM (different lobby/game tracks), per-player private items with route lengths within 10%, shared goal, HUD player statuses, leavers vanish. Host on Vercel, code in GitHub. Earlier ask: optional side-by-side stereo (cams 6.3 cm apart, parallel).

Open questions asked 2026-10-24 in thread: repo name; realtime service (recommended Supabase Realtime + Metered TURN vs PeerJS no-account); procedural synth music OK?; stereo default (proposed toggle, default Normal); action button meaning (proposed pick-up); expected player count for "yet to join".

Answers 2026-10-24: stereo toggle YES (default Normal). Music: use free royalty-free J-Pop-style tracks (not synth), credit as license requires. User creating GitHub repo (name pending). Realtime: PartyKit hosted platform shut down 2026-10-23; recommended Ably free tier (6M msg/mo, 200 conns) for lobby+signaling, positions over WebRTC data channels, key in Vercel env ABLY_API_KEY + token function. Awaiting user confirmation.

**Why:** later threads must not re-ask. **How to apply:** update with answers when received. User prefs: plain text chat, no docs unless asked, blunt assessments.

Free-tier facts verified 2026-10-24 (vendor pages): Supabase Free 200 conns, 2M msg/mo, 100 msg/s, 20 presence msg/s, pauses after 7 days low DB activity. Ably Free 200 conns, 6M msg/mo (sent+received count), 500 msg/s, 200 presence/channel, no card. PartyKit hosted shut down 23 Oct 2026 (confirmed blog); successor PartyServer on own Cloudflare Workers Free: DO 100k req/day, incoming WS msgs billed 20:1, 13,000 GB-s/day. TURN: Metered 500 MB/mo free; Open Relay 20 GB/mo; Cloudflare Realtime TURN 1,000 GB/mo free.
